Name: Ore Irradiator
Author: iwanofuu
Description:
1. Buy "Ore Irradiator" recipe from Qi's Walnut Room stock;
[img]https://github.com/valery-iwanofu/StardewMods/raw/master/OreIrradiator/docs/1.jpg[/img]
2. Craft "Ore Irradiator";
[img]https://github.com/valery-iwanofu/StardewMods/raw/master/OreIrradiator/docs/2.jpg[/img]
3. Place "Ore Irradiator" somewhere and put some ore with coal in it;
[img]https://github.com/valery-iwanofu/StardewMods/raw/master/OreIrradiator/docs/3.jpg[/img]
4. Wait some time and pick up the radioactive ore
[img]https://github.com/valery-iwanofu/StardewMods/raw/master/OreIrradiator/docs/4.jpg[/img]

[code]For 4-6 radioactive ore you need 25/20/15/10 copper/iron/gold/irridium ores and 1 coal.[/code]
Source code: [url=https://github.com/valery-iwanofu/StardewMods/tree/master/OreIrradiator]Github[/url]

Manifest.Name: OreIrradiator
Manifest.Description: Adds an "Ore Irradiator" machine to convert ordinary ore into radioactive ore
Manifest.Author: Iwanofu
